name: DeleteItemVersionInput
description: Represents the input for deleting an item version.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the item database

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the item. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: version
inputFields.description: The version of the item to be deleted. If not specified, the latest version will be deleted.
